newsitem.title: YEMEN: U.S. team to help Yemen clear mines from 1994 war.
newsitem.headline: U.S. team to help Yemen clear mines from 1994 war.

text.p: A team of U.S. experts is expected to arrive in Yemen soon to help the Arab state clear mines from the 1994 civil war that nearly tore the country apart, a government official said on Saturday.
"The team will carry out field surveys...around the southern city of Aden and neighbouring areas," he told Reuters. He gave no date.
Aden was the capital of South Yemen which united with North Yemen in 1990.
Yemen has said about one third of the estimated 66,000 mines planted by some of the leaders who launched the southern separatist campaign that sparked the two-month war had been removed.
Several Yemenis have been killed or wounded by mines.
